propositions: The retired 'recheck-review' trigger word collides with the external CI ChatOps 'recheck' key because the substring matcher in gerrit_to_platform.ini.template treats any comment containing 'recheck' as a CI dispatch, accidentally cancelling in-flight verification runs.
The bot's own reply texts embed the retired trigger word verbatim, causing the bot's own Gerrit comments to re-dispatch the CI workflow instead of just the user command.

The new trigger token 'rerun-llm-review' must share no substring in either direction with any [mapping 'comment-added'] key in the ini template, and this property must be enforced at test time by parsing the ini file rather than hardcoding.
The retired-word comment must post exactly one refusal reply (after project guard and change re-anchoring) naming the new trigger, but must never enqueue a review or write a label.
